 CBS News Videos Updated Mon, October 19, 2026 at 9:42 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. President Trump is heading to Kansas to stump for Sen. Roger Marshall as polls show Marshall in a close race against Democrat Adam Hamilton, despite Mr. Trump's 16-point victory margin there in the 2024 election. CBS News chief White House correspondent Nancy Cordes reports.
